host_baseline.basis: measured once with the pinned host and a role's structured-output tool (athena.toml [agents]); not measured per invocation

input.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

output.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_read.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_write.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cost.basis: Claude Code total_cost_usd, at list price

commands_run: cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core job_size 2>&1
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core --test refusal_corpus -q 2>&1
cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1 && cargo test -p xtask --test policy -q 2>&1

policy_denials.detail: grep -n "scope_limit\|^## \|^### " CHANGELOG.md | head -20; ls <job>/evidence; git status --short | head
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core job_size 2>&1 | tail -40
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core 2>&1 | grep -E "^test result|FAILED|failed|panicked|error"

python3 -I - <<'EOF'
import re
p='crates/athena-core/tests/refusal_corpus.rs'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''        "athena.toml",
        ".github/workflows/ci.yml",
        "crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs",
    ];
    vec![''','''        "athena.toml",
        "docs/guide.md",
        "crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs",
    ];
    vec![''')
s=s.replace('''                "athena.toml carries the key",
                ".github/workflows/ci.yml runs the check",
                "The reading code checks it",''','''                "athena.toml carries the key",
                "The guide describes the key",
                "The reading code checks it",''')
s=s.replace('"the bound itself: more than 30 deliverables in one crate; built for the check"','"the bounds of the check (3 groups, 30 deliverables); built for the check"')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core --test refusal_corpus -q 2>&1
